limitations: Native current-to-master and repeat timing comparisons retain positive regressions beyond the unchanged 15 percent threshold.
The isolated culling gain is not a general frame-rate improvement.
Warm snapshot-index preparation is measured separately from render-only timing.
Only one hardware GPU and software adapter were available.
Texture bandwidth and utilization counters are unavailable.
Logical mesh/stream payload and DXGI usage are separate measurements.
Debug layer unavailable; zero messages do not establish debug-clean execution.
No asynchronous mesh eviction, occlusion feedback, temporal history or vendor upscaling SDK.
Fixed immutable renderables and lightweight entities do not establish active large-battle simulation performance.
Scaled shallow-depth/transparent edges and continuous motion still require visual acceptance.
